header.subtitle: Pursuing clarity in an intricate world

about.summary: Engineer who scales early-stage services to production level and builds tools from scratch when they don't exist. Currently serving as Part Lead, owning core domains end-to-end—from design through operation—for a 360° spatial AI SaaS platform deployed across 6 regions, accountable for stability and data consistency in a multi-region environment.
highlights: Built asset classification and tracking system end-to-end (ERD to SDK) and panorama image AI preprocessing pipeline across 4 repositories from scratch
Scaled AI image generation system from prototype to 1M+ monthly requests, reducing infrastructure costs by 20% and CDN costs by 80%+
Developed and released 3 open source projects for the Tibero developer ecosystem with 70% Docker image size reduction

experience.description: Global 360° spatial AI SaaS company serving construction and facility management markets. Leading backend development and team management, driving design and implementation of core domains including asset management, BIM integration, AI preprocessing pipelines, and construction progress tracking.

achievements.title: Designed and Built an Enterprise Asset Management System—from Data Model to Bulk API
details: Designed data model with Closure Table-based hierarchical categories and FormWorkflow/FormStatus state machine, implementing full API from CRUD to Bulk operations
Implemented data integrity validation in Bulk API—UUID deduplication, circular reference and self-loop prevention—guaranteeing integrity for enterprise CSV mass import
Delivered enterprise-grade features including PaperTrail-based audit trail, hierarchical FormField inheritance, and attachment/comment/thumbnail capabilities

achievements.title: Led Architecture Design and Implementation of a Lightweight Construction Progress-Tracking Platform
details: Codified infrastructure as code with Terraform (ECS Fargate, SQS, OpenSearch, IAM policies) and implemented backend API, Processing Agent, and SDK
Architected a state machine and Kinesis-based event streaming, establishing an event integration foundation between service tiers
Built Element-ElementRecord data consistency Validation API, systematically detecting and resolving MySQL-MongoDB discrepancies for enterprise customers

achievements.title: Built a Panorama Object-Detection AI Preprocessing Pipeline from Scratch
details: Added GPU queue-based AI preprocessing stage to capture processing pipeline, designing async architecture with ECS Task and SQS
Delivered end-to-end implementation across 4 repositories—from infrastructure definition to agent development, backend state management API, and OpenAPI SDK
Implemented region-specific routing logic supporting multi-region deployment

achievements.title: Optimized Infrastructure: Eliminated 100ms Blocking and Achieved Zero-Data-Loss Operation
details: Eliminated 100ms Redis blocking by migrating KEYS to SCAN, and improved fault isolation by separating cache and queue into dedicated ElastiCache instances
Resolved TaskSyncWorker race condition through phased approach: Redis cache lock for immediate mitigation, then RetryWorker for systematic recovery
Established Datadog-based monitoring (SLO, Error Tracking, APM) and operated deployments across 6 regions (US, EU, AU, JP, CA, NSW Gov) with zero data loss via automated retry

experience.description: Focused on service optimization and building infrastructure for enhanced developer productivity.

achievements.title: Improved Developer Productivity and Test Automation in a Closed DBMS Environment (Tibero)
details: Developed Tibero Docker/TestContainer, eliminating per-developer local test DB setup overhead and reducing team-wide environment configuration costs
Achieved 70% Docker image size reduction (1.5GB → 401MB) by applying zstd compression algorithm and removing unnecessary files
Integrated Tibero TestContainer into CI/CD pipelines, automating database-dependent tests and ensuring consistent test environments
Analyzed Flyway core logic and developed Tibero-specific dialect for automated DDL version control, streamlining schema deployment process
Released 3 internally validated projects as open source, contributing to the expansion of Tibero developer ecosystem

experience.description: Led backend development for MiriCanvas AI Drawing service.

achievements.title: Built AI Image Generation Service Backend from Scratch
details: Scaled from early prototype to production system handling 1M+ monthly image generation requests reliably
Designed asynchronous processing pipeline integrating external AI model APIs (OpenAI, Stability AI)
Integrated DALL·E 3, achieving 40% increase in daily image requests

achievements.title: Optimized Infrastructure Costs, Achieving 20% Monthly Reduction
details: Implemented request classification logic by characteristics (resolution, model) to optimize GPU resource utilization
Applied instance downsizing (g5.2xlarge → g5.xlarge) based on workload analysis
Reduced spot instance setup time by 40% (25min → 15min) through AMI optimization and prewarming strategy

achievements.title: Reduced CDN Costs 80%+ with Lambda@Edge Real-time Image Transformation
details: Implemented Lambda function for real-time PNG → WebP conversion at CloudFront origin response
Achieved 75% average file size reduction through image format conversion, reducing CDN transfer costs by 80%+
Designed architecture enabling gradual migration without modifying existing S3 storage

achievements.title: Resolved Admin Server Concurrency Issues with Redis Distributed Lock
details: Resolved ID collision issues caused by AutoIncrement PK changes using Redis-based distributed lock
Implemented AOP-based automatic retry logic ensuring graceful handling during lock conflicts
Eliminated data loss issues from designer work conflicts, improved concurrency control within legacy constraints
